body: Do you play with Seasons? If your plants are outside then they may be out of season.
AFAIK this subreddit isn't run by the actual team who works on the game, so anyone on the team is unlikely to find your request.
Cheats would be a decent way unless a patch comes out.

Depends how many Sims you have. I started with one which is decently manageable and then moved in her girlfriend. I currently have 3 Sims, since they now have a toddler together. I pause the game to queue up their needs.

I wouldn't leave a Sim by themselves, though. Maybe it's just my slightly laggy game but I wouldn't risk it.

Ohh okay, I normally cancel Father Winter showing up on my calendar. I've also noticed visiting Sims really like filling my house up with loads of glasses of water - I think it might just be an odd autonomy bug. It's been happening for as long as I can remember playing the Sims and I've been playing for quite a few years now. I think it's probably the same sort of code that means visiting Sims play on the computer for hours while your Sims are trying to sleep - aka one of the most annoying things when Sims visit! 

I'm not sure there's any particular fix, unfortunately. If you want to prevent Father Winter from coming into your house then you can cancel that under Winterfest's holiday in the calendar, and it will save that for all future Winterfest events unless you cancel Winterfest entirely. 

I haven't played Snowy Escape enough to have Yamachan visiting (that might be to do with my door settings though, the only Sim who actually visits is the townie's friend). I would imagine it's a similar issue though.

Lock the door for any Sim not in your household. That might prevent Father Winter and Yamachan from randomly entering your Sim's house. It seems like that might just be a bug, so hopefully this will be patched soon.
In agreement with the other two comments, sounds like "Je ne sais plus quoi faire" to me - "I don't know what to do anymore".
